surfaces.name: Detection Stats
surfaces.guarantee: Reusable canonical detector provenance, per-frame scores, decisions, and metrics can be rendered into downstream outputs without re-running detection.

surfaces.name: Scene Timeline

surfaces.name: Browser workbench
surfaces.guarantee: Local video analysis, detector configuration, Scene List/timeline review, and export run without uploading selected media to an application server.

surfaces.name: Browser/native decode parity
surfaces.guarantee: The browser surface does not claim native FFmpeg decode parity or complete VFR presentation equivalence.
